extraction.ocr_text:
Add evaluator
Select a type that corresponds to your needs.

○  LLM-as-a-judge: Semantic Similarity
   Create your own LLM-based evaluator.

○  Trajectory
   Create your own trajectory evaluator.

◉  Exact match
   Checks if the output precisely matches the expected output without any variations in wording,
   formatting.

JSON similarity
○  Checking if two JSON structures or values are 'close enough' or share a similar
   structure/contents

○  CSV Column Exact Match  Preview
   Evaluates CSV output by matching exact values in specified columns against expected values

○  Context precision
   An evaluator that scores the relevancy of Context Grounding results to the user's query.

○  Faithfulness
   An evaluator that scores whether claims in the agent output are grounded in the provided
   context.

Cancel    Continue

×
extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath Agents evaluation modal titled "Add evaluator." A list of evaluator types is displayed, and the "Exact match" evaluator is selected and visually emphasized with a red rectangle. The modal includes Cancel and Continue buttons at the bottom right.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the "Exact match" evaluator option if it is not already selected. Click on the "Continue" button to proceed with adding this evaluator.
